verdict.rationale: Motion's docs show adjacent capabilities but nothing that directly matches this story. It offers a booking page that exposes your 'ideal time slots' to prospects, merges your own Outlook/Google/iCloud calendars into one view, enforces daily meeting caps, and automatically reshuffles your day and week when meetings run long. None of this shows the AI searching across all attendees' calendars to pick an optimal shared time, or re-optimizing meeting times over time. Missing for 10: cross-attendee calendar analysis for meeting placement, evidence of choosing an optimal rather than first-available slot, continuous re-optimization of scheduled meetings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
